text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — AcmeCorp marketplace onboarding across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need clear owners for IAM/KMS, legal amendments, SKU packaging, and a joint launch plan. Who can take which piece?

kevin-cloud: I can own cloud creds + IAM templates for all three clouds. Will draft role + KMS policy and a cross-account STS example. ETA: EOD Tue.

maria-partnerships: Thanks @kevin-cloud. Important: include cross-account STS for the publisher flow and an example of how Acme should call AssumeRole.

kevin-cloud: Yep. quick sample for AWS publisher AssumeRole:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher"
    }
  ]
}
```

devon-legal: Heads-up — Acme is asking for explicit SOC2 + KMS rotation language in the offer. I'll draft an amendment and mark required fields in the listing. Also need final SKU definitions to surface in the contract.

anya-product: I'll own SKU mapping and the trial flows. @sophie-ops can you confirm trial entitlements, support contact, and telemetry/metrics we need to surface in the listing?

sophie-ops: On it. For Dedicated customers we need a separate SKU and trial metadata (duration, termination). Also confirm we expose a support email and support level in the offer.

maria-partnerships: Timeline check — partners want a joint blog + webinar. I propose we gate public launch on legal sign-off + staging screenshots. Is that ok?

devon-legal: Legal sign-off target is Thu if we have IAM templates + a draft offer by Wed. I'll prioritize the KMS rotation clause and RG/retention notes.

lin-eng: I'll assemble a staging demo image and the publisher portal walkthrough (screenshots + short video). Need exact SKU strings from @anya-product to build manifest.

anya-product: Draft SKU names: ["redwood-inference-core", "redwood-inference-dedicated", "redwood-inference-private-trial"]. Can revise if legal flags anything.

kevin-cloud: Those look good. I'll add them into the packaging manifest and prepare a Terraform snippet for the publisher resource mapping.

release-bot: New doc uploaded: /docs/marketplace/acme-onboard-v1.md

maria-partnerships: Nice. Next steps summarized: @kevin-cloud -> IAM + manifest by Wed EOD; @anya-product -> SKU doc + screenshots; @devon-legal -> finalize clauses by Thu. Weekly sync Thurs 10:00am to review. :thumbsup:

kevin-cloud: Confirmed. Will ping when IAM PR is up.

devon-legal: I'll post the amendment draft in this thread when ready.

lin-eng: Will start building the staging image today. Will need a test account for Acme staging (requesting creds).

maria-partnerships: I'll arrange staging account with partner PM and drop creds to slack-safe. Thanks everyone — moving to action items.
